public_snapshot.source: SocialCounts public tracker; historical snapshot, not live private YouTube Analytics

channel_positioning.opportunity: Practical Nepali-language technology education with stronger packaging and repeatable series

audit_score.reason: A defensible channel score needs impressions, CTR, watch time, retention, traffic sources and audience data; these are not available from public channel statistics alone.

diagnosis: The channel has a practical technology foundation, but the stated topic range is broad; stronger content pillars should make the channel easier to understand and package.

The public snapshot shows 151 videos and about 42.9K total views as of 2026-08-02. That is a substantial back-catalog relative to the current audience size, so packaging and topic selection deserve priority.

The strongest strategic advantage is Nepali-language practical technology education. AI tools, creator workflows, mobile editing, productivity and Nepal-specific digital problems can become repeatable series.
Public data cannot establish CTR, retention, watch time or traffic-source performance. Those must not be fabricated; they require YouTube Analytics authorization.
